method: Every case of the local receipt-scanner dataset (139 synthetic receipts and screenshots, manifest sourceHash 0f928af7faa1c4b2) POSTed through the Worker's real fetch handler with RevenueCat and the quota mocked and the bundled prompts (byte-identical to hosted version 1, which production serves). Live OpenRouter calls with a separate local key on the production OpenRouter account. A case passes when the transaction count, every amount, the category and (screenshots) the account match, and for itemized scans the item count and item sum.
